ChallengesHelp Western readers understand the political land

runs.t: Help Western readers understand the political landscape as Xi Jinping rose to power
Activate a dense dataset compiled over a year by 20+ Reuters journalists
Build a data-rich interactive story for early iPad hardware with limited time-zone overlap
Prototyped in live code, reviewed with the journalism team, and iterated repeatedly
Used daily standups to coordinate design, development, content, and editorial decisions
Led design and project management across a distributed team of designers, developers, and writers
Won the Data Journalism Award and Deadline Club Award
Earned recognition from Fast Company, SABEW, and Best American Infographics
Created an interactive form for making opaque political power structures easier to explore

blocks.text: Fathom collaborated with Reuters to find an interactive form

runs.t: Fathom collaborated with Reuters to find an interactive form for the dataset the China news desk had been amassing for over a year. I served as lead designer as well as project manager for the 3–5 additional designers, developers, and content writers working together to make it a reality.
